name: iBabs Stem to decidesk Vote
description: Maps an individual iBabs stem (RIS vote record) onto decidesk's Vote schema. iBabs stemwaarde voor/tegen/onthouding maps to value for/against/abstain. weight defaults to 1. castAt comes from the stemDatum, falling back to the parent besluitDatum.

mapping.value: {% set v = (values.stemwaarde ?? values.waarde ?? values.value ?? '')|lower %}{% if v == 'voor' or v == 'for' %}for{% elseif v == 'tegen' or v == 'against' %}against{% elseif v == 'onthouding' or v == 'blanco' or v == 'abstain' %}abstain{% else %}{% endif %}
